title: Exercise ordinary task-sync overlap refusal and reconciled resume through the CLI
outcome: Protect manual conflict resolution and the ordinary sync resume path with behavior tests.
acceptance: A two-host CLI regression edits the same task, confirms the merge is left pending, and then resumes an edited resolution with --reconciled. The committed merge retains the peer tip and imports before updating the remote.
CLI cases verify refusal of --reconciled without a merge and direct the operator to --reconciled when a merge is pending.
